name: starter
description: A small, opinionated user-level setup: ask-before-assuming and verify-before-done rules injected at session start, a review gate, an opt-in cycle (gather, plan, plan review, build, code review, probe) that hands off through a plan file to role agents (reader, writer, reviewer) whose model and effort you choose with a profile in /config, a /phase pane, a visual-plan skill, safe worktree cleanup, and a monthly review with optional context7 MCP server.

profile.title: Agent profile
profile.description: Model and effort of the reader, writer and reviewer agents: max (sonnet/opus, as the plugin ships), balanced, or light (cheaper). A role field below set to anything but "profile" wins.

reader_model.title: Reader model
reader_model.description: Model of the reader agent; "profile" takes it from the profile.

reader_effort.description: Effort of the reader agent; "profile" takes it from the profile.
